newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia investment growth on track-Treasury.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia investment growth on track-Treasury.

text.p: A senior Australian Treasury official said on Monday aggregate investment growth was on track to meet forecasts for 1997/98 (July-June).

The official told a parliamentary hearing that Treasury had forecast aggregate investment to increase 2.6 percent over the previous year. Asked to describe that increase, the official said: "On track."
